headline: Star Housing Finance director ceases office
summary: Amlendra Prasad Saxena ceased to be an Independent Director of Star Housing Finance Ltd on October 23, 2026, after completing his tenure.

headline: BHEL appoints two senior management heads
summary: Bharat Heavy Electricals Ltd appointed Rajeeva Srivastava and Amit Gupta as heads of International Operations and Defence & Aerospace Business Group respectively, effective October 25, 2026.

headline: NIIT Learning to host Q2FY27 earnings call
summary: NIIT Learning Systems Limited will host an investor call on October 29, 2026, to discuss unaudited financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.

headline: Fratelli Vineyards sets rights issue price
summary: Fratelli Vineyards will decide the issue price and ratio for its ₹30 crore rights issue on October 26, 2026.

headline: BCCL Q2FY27 PAT turns positive at ₹124 crore
summary: Bharat Coking Coal Limited reported a standalone net profit of ₹123.74 crore in Q2FY27, reversing the previous quarter's loss. Revenue rose 39% YoY to ₹4,412.58 crore.

headline: RailTel Q2FY27 Results: PAT down 10% YoY
summary: RailTel Corporation of India Limited reported a 10% YoY decline in net profit to ₹6,856 lakh for Q2FY27. Revenue rose 20% to ₹1,14,614 lakh. Board declared ₹1 interim dividend.
